title: Directed neighborhood travel time with a forbidden turn
prompt: Use fixtures/network.json to calculate the least travel time from origin A to every listed destination. Respect directed edges and every forbidden turn; optimize time_minutes rather than geometric distance. Write outputs/travel-times.csv, outputs/routes.geojson, and outputs/summary.json. Include unreachable destinations explicitly instead of dropping them. Route geometry and reported node paths must agree, and all outputs must retain the fixture's projected CRS and minute units.
invariants: Travel time, not Euclidean distance, determines the optimal route.
The directed forbidden turn A to B to E must never appear in a route.
Every destination is reported, including unreachable destination G.
Route coordinates follow the reported ordered node path exactly.
The projected EPSG:32636 CRS and minute units remain explicit.
